ProvcheckC2PA.description: Free, open (Apache-2.0) provcheck for ComfyUI — one node for image, audio, and video. WRITE: embed the free watermark (TrustMark on images, silentcipher on the audio track of audio/video) and/or C2PA-sign with your local key + atproto/Bluesky identity, optionally recording the generation graph; the signed file is written to your output directory. READ: detect/verify a provcheck mark on each connected input. Wire in an image, audio, video, or any mix. Every option is a widget you can also wire in from another node, including the output filename. Creative Mayhem also makes Backfire, a keyed mark that AI stripping amplifies instead of removes (commercial add-on, not in this free pack): https://provcheck.ai/backfire . More: https://provcheck.ai

mode.name: mode
mode.tooltip: write = watermark and/or C2PA-sign each connected input (most common). read = detect/verify an existing provcheck mark.

image.name: image
image.tooltip: Optional image batch to write to / read from.

audio.name: audio
audio.tooltip: Optional audio to write to / read from.

video.name: video
video.tooltip: Optional video. The watermark rides the audio track (frames are preserved); the container is C2PA-signed.

watermark.name: watermark
watermark.tooltip: [write] Embed the free FOSS watermark (TrustMark image / silentcipher audio).

c2pa_sign.name: c2pa_sign
c2pa_sign.tooltip: [write] C2PA-sign with your local signing key. The signed file is written to your ComfyUI output directory.

embed_identity.name: embed_identity
embed_identity.tooltip: [write] Embed your atproto/Bluesky identity (DID + handle) in the manifest so a verifier sees who signed it. Needs kit login.

record_provenance.name: record_provenance
record_provenance.tooltip: [write] Record a curated summary of the generation graph (model, seed, sampler, prompts) into the signed manifest.

include_full_workflow.name: include_full_workflow
include_full_workflow.tooltip: [write] With record_provenance: embed the FULL (redacted) workflow, not just the summary. Off by default to avoid leaking prompts/paths.

brand_id.name: brand_id
brand_id.tooltip: [write] Your 5-bit brand id from the atproto brand registry (0-31). Default 2 is the public rAIdio.bot id; use your own.

filename_prefix.name: filename_prefix
filename_prefix.tooltip: [write, when a file is written] Output filename prefix for the signed/watermarked files. Editable, and can be wired in from another node (right-click -> Convert to input).
